Frank Bisignano donates to Trump Accounts for children in Brooklyn, NY
Oct. 29, 2026 – Today, Frank J. Bisignano, a native of Brooklyn’s Old Mill Basin neighborhood, announced a donation from The Bisignano Family Fund to the Trump Accounts of children living in his hometown zip code.
IRS launches new mobile app, expanding digital services for taxpayers
IR-2026-114, Sept. 25, 2026 — The IRS today announced the launch of the new IRS mobile app, replacing IRS2Go and expanding the agency’s digital services to give taxpayers more ways to securely access IRS tools and account services from their mobile devices.
IRS releases tax inflation adjustments for tax year 2027; taxpayers continue to benefit from the Working Families Tax Cuts
IR-2026-133, Nov. 5, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today announced the tax year 2027 annual inflation adjustments for almost 70 tax provisions, including the tax rate schedules, standard deduction amounts and other tax changes. Revenue Procedure 2026-35 provides details about these annual adjustments.
IRS expands Tax Pro Account for business client payments
IR-2026-134, Nov. 6, 2026 — The IRS today announced that authorized tax professionals can now make certain payments on behalf of their business clients through Tax Pro Account.
